item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong Srettha-specific 2024 evidence on procurement self-dealing, pardon abuse, or a direct paper trail of personal financial corruption. The evidence is concentrated in appointments, public messaging, press freedom, and institutional scrutiny. So the best-supported reading is not “proven personal corruption,” but rather ethically compromised political practice with some countervailing technocratic and transparency signals.","evidence":[{"title":"Court dismissal over ethical breach","publisher":"Public Relations Department, Thailand","date":"2024-08-14","url":"https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/48/iid/315614","summary":"Srettha was removed after the Constitutional Court found an ethics violation tied to appointing Pichit Chuenban.
